title: Frankenstein, or The Modern Prometheus - 00 - Letters
summary:
Frankenstein, or The Modern Prometheus by . Victor Frankenstein discovers the secret of animating lifeless matter and, by assembling body parts, creates the monster who has no name in the book. Rejected by society, the Monster vows revenge on his creator. (Summary written by Gesine)
